trust_decision.summary: The LINQ3 filter-field translators decide whether a path segment taken from a folded application constant (dictionary/BsonDocument key, Mql.Field name, array-filter identifier) may be joined with '.' into a filter/update element name; at the pinned commit no segment is validated before AstFilterField.SubField concatenates it.

landing_point.why: The fix commit title ('LINQ filter and update field paths silently target a different field') points to dictionary indexer translation x.D[key]. The advisory summary (symbol-interning DoS) would instead send an engineer to src/MongoDB.Bson/ObjectModel/BsonSymbolTable.cs:24-40, which already does no interning, so it is not where the fix is.

same public APIs with x.D[key] (Dictionary indexer, Document representation)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Aggregation-expression side, a second translator family for the same LINQ methods: fix.diff:67-104 (FieldMethodToAggregationExpressionTranslator, GetItemMethodToAggregationExpressionTranslator). The fallback coupling is the other out-of-scope piece: src/MongoDB.Driver/Linq/Linq3Implementation/Translators/ExpressionToFilterTranslators/ExpressionToFilterTranslator.cs:35-47 catches ExpressionNotSupportedException and retries with aggregation operators.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: '$getField takes the name as data, so the aggregation side is not injectable.' Separately, a check that throws the usual ExpressionNotSupportedException looks correct but is swallowed by the query-operator→aggregation fallback (ExpressionToFilterTranslator.cs:44-46), so the dotted key silently changes meaning instead of failing.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Nested $-prefixed keys (x.D["$ne"] → 'D.$ne') must keep rendering and matching literally. Driver-generated positional segments $[] / $ / $[identifier] (AllElements, FirstMatchingElement, AllMatchingElements) must keep working, so a blanket '$' or '.' ban in AstFilterField.SubField or Render breaks them. Array indexes and discriminator sub-fields also go through SubField.

O6_input_shapes: dotted segment 'a.b' (path split, a parser differential on identity)
$-prefixed segment as the first path component ($where/$expr/$or), including inside Any/$elemMatch (@<elem>)
array-filter identifier containing ']' or '.', an uppercase/digit first char, or null (would widen to $[])
string key vs a dictionary key that serializes to a string through a key serializer (object key)

O7_producer.where: src/MongoDB.Driver/Linq/Linq3Implementation/Ast/Filters/AstFilterField.cs:39-53 (SubField concatenates, Render emits the element name); fed by translators that fold closure constants

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a key/field-name-taking dictionary predicate (for example a TryGetValue- or Keys.Contains-style translator) that builds fieldTranslation.Ast.SubField(key) without EnsureSegmentIsSafe
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ContainsKey sits in MethodTranslators, not ToFilterFieldTranslators, and was itself a site; a sibling dictionary predicate written the same way is a plausible maintainer addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a projection-into-field path whose subFieldName comes from a folded constant instead of a member name
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same SubField idiom is used there; only the data source differs.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second catch-and-retry strategy (regex at StringExpressionToRegexFilterTranslator.cs:115,135) that would re-route a rejected name if the validator threw ExpressionNotSupportedException
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fallbacks already exist. A how-type trap: the fix only holds with a distinct exception type.

O9_family: injection: unvalidated element-name / field-path construction (path-segment split) in a query builder; advisory metadata says CWE-770 resource exhaustion, which does not match the fix

services: mongod (only for the LinqIntegrationTest execution asserts; Render/Translate asserts need no server)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject '.'/'$' in the dictionary-indexer translator with ExpressionNotSupportedException, which the filter fallback catches and silently retranslates via $getField, or ban '$' in AstFilterField.SubField, which breaks positional $[] and nested 'D.$ne'.

out_of_scope_notes: Advisory summary/CWE (unbounded symbol interning, CWE-770) does not match the fix commit (CSHARP-6181 LINQ field-path injection); BsonSymbolTable at the pinned commit already does not intern (src/MongoDB.Bson/ObjectModel/BsonSymbolTable.cs:23,32-39).
StringFieldDefinition / string-path builders accept dotted paths by design; not treated as a route.
